name: Ginko
source:
Hobbies: Playing with Kousuke and children
Likes: The mountain of Minakami village
Hates: ???

A woman with mysterious aura whom Kousuke met when he came to Minakami village. 
It is unknown whether her name is real or not. She seems to know Kousuke from the past and call him "Kou-chan" intimately. A person who acts on impulse. While at the first glance she is a real beauty, she has a quite eccentric personality. She likes to tease and plays pranks on people, especially Kousuke. Even though she teases him with dirty joke and romance a lot, she unexpectedly very shy when he teases her back. 
Often caught playing together with the village kids.

She seems to know a lot about the history of Minakami village.  

[Based on [url=http://www.applique-soft.com/sin/cha_05.html]the official website[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real identity is that she is the youngest sister of Tennyo whom Minakami village worshipped. She came down to earth to clean the mess her sisters left behind. She is also known as Shirogane-sama[/spoiler].
